subject: Cohort subsidy tranche routing and sponsor split (Foundry Labs)
messages:
From: Maya Sharma <maya@foundrylabs.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T09:10:00Z
Subject: Cohort credits — multiple sponsors + conversion question

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Foundry Labs is excited to recommend Redwood to our next accelerator cohort. Two quick operational questions before we proceed:

1) We have two sponsors (VentureBridge and LocalFoundry) who want to co-fund the cohort stipend. Can credits be provisioned as "tranches" tied to sponsor invoices so we can show split usage on our side?

2) Some founders want the option to convert unused promo credits into a short Dedicated trial (reserved capacity) for their longer-running inference workloads. Is there any way to get a temporary exception to allow conversion for this cohort?

Attaching our program profile.

Appreciate any guidance,

--
Maya Sharma
Program Director, Foundry Labs
maya@foundrylabs.com
(415) 555-0121
Attachment: Foundry_Startup_Profile.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Maya Sharma <maya@foundrylabs.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Cohort credits — multiple sponsors + conversion question

Hi Maya — great to hear and congrats on lining up two sponsors. Short answers below and a proposed operational model attached.

- Tranches: Yes — we can create named credit tranches per sponsor and surface consumption per tranche in the Console billing view. Each tranche is treated as a promotional balance tied to the account and labelled by sponsor.

- Conversion to Dedicated: Not standard, but we do support a temporary waiver path for pilots where converted units are mapped to a short-term Dedicated allocation (30 days) for specific teams. Requires approvals from Finance + Product Ops.

Proposed next steps (attached: tranche_model_v1.xlsx):
- Create 3 tranches: Foundry-onboarding ($3k), VentureBridge sponsor ($6k), LocalFoundry sponsor ($4k).
- Implement a conditional top-up clause: if combined usage > 75% by week 3, auto-release a $2k emergency tranche.
- Sponsor reporting: CSV export per tranche for your accounting team.

Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the sheet? If this looks reasonable I will route the waiver to Finance for the conversion exception.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 650-555-3344
Attachment: tranche_model_v1.xlsx

Hi all — looping in details from pricing/finance so expectations are clear.

Key constraints and options:
- Promo tranches: straightforward; we can do N labelled tranches and export usage. No problem.
- Conversion exception: our policy disallows direct conversion of promotional credit to billable Dedicated capacity by default. Exception path requires: sponsor commitment letters, expected consumption profile, and a short commercial addendum signed by the sponsor or Foundry (Finance needs to see sponsor names on the routing).
- Temporary pilot window: we can approve a 30-day Dedicated pilot conversion for up to $5k total (across all founders) if the sponsor(s) commit in writing and the cohort provides a usage plan. Anything above $5k requires VP Finance sign-off.

Operational asks for approvals:
1) Sponsor commitment PDFs (signed).
2) Expected cohort usage by week (CSV).
3) Point of contact for invoicing.

If Foundry can provide the above, I'll draft the short addendum and route to Finance.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Maya Sharma <maya@foundrylabs.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-14T10:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Cohort credits — multiple sponsors + conversion question

Thanks Maya — a couple of partner ops notes from my side:

- We prefer sponsor commitments to include (1) sponsor legal name, (2) billing contact, (3) max committed amount, and (4) a short statement that credits are for the Foundry cohort. This helps our reconciliation team.
- For sponsor reporting, we can publish a weekly CSV with per-tranche consumption and founder email mapping (consent permitting).
- On the conversion waiver: we will need a short use-case justification per founder that wants Dedicated (model size, expected token volume). That prevents speculative conversions.

If you'd like, we can template the sponsor letter — saves time. Also adding a link to the standard addendum draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-foundry-tranche-spec

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
